title: John Lear: a billion aliens live in the mountains by a highway

tellings.quote: he used to tell me there were aliens living in the mountains

plain: A man named John Lear used to say that aliens, as many as a billion, live inside the mountains along a highway. Bob Lazar, who knew Lear in the 1980s, repeats this to Michels as something Lear "used to tell me". He passes it on as one of Lear's ideas, without saying whether he believes it himself.
